title: GUI clipboard metafile policy gate
contracts: OpenClipboard is a Sandboxie box policy for clipboard access
GuiServer GetClipboardDataSlave enforces OpenClipboard before opening the clipboard
GuiServer GetClipboardMetaFileSlave is a secondary CF_METAFILEPICT read broker and must enforce the same OpenClipboard policy
OpenClipboard denied path returns GUI_GET_CLIPBOARD_DATA_RPL with result zero and ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
GetClipboardMetaFileSlave must not call OpenClipboard NULL before the policy check passes
Allowed callers preserve the existing CF_METAFILEPICT GetClipboardData GlobalLock GetMetaFileBitsEx section-copy topology
Windows runtime proof is still required for SbieSvc DLL clipboard behavior
local_edges: OpenClipboard false -> result zero error ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED
OpenClipboard true -> OpenClipboard NULL -> GetClipboardData CF_METAFILEPICT -> GlobalLock -> GetMetaFileBitsEx -> GetClipboardDataSlave2
runtime_gate: Windows SbieSvc and DLL build with OpenClipboard=n denied CF_METAFILEPICT broker read and OpenClipboard=y ordinary plus metafile clipboard smoke
